func_8000A5C4_B1C4.title: Reset a kind-2 display record
func_8000A5C4_B1C4.summary: Copies the native kind-2 reset template while preserving its free-list link.
behavior: Resets the 0x98-byte CPU display/model record from the native template and restores the original word at +0x00. This preserves a free-list next pointer while clearing pose, material, segment and cached-tree state.
The template sets byte +0x04 to 0x82 (retired kind 2), byte +0x05 to 5, and byte +0x65 to 1. Allocation clears the retirement bit; native visibility accepts a nonnegative signed +0x65.
cautions: Only reset a detached or newly provisioned record. Resetting a live tree node can orphan its children and owner links.
Storage must cover 0x98 bytes. Native model records have an 8-byte-aligned stride.

func_80035BF8_367F8.title: Reset the kind-2 free list
func_80035BF8_367F8.summary: Rebuilds the stock kind-2 free list and resets its active count.
behavior: Links exactly 192 records of stride 0x98 in native system storage, terminates the final next pointer, and sets the signed 16-bit kind-2 active counter to zero.
This replaces the free head at D_8016DAC0[2]. It does not discover separately allocated storage and does not copy the record reset template; native template initialization is a separate operation.
cautions: A lifecycle reset invalidates outstanding record ownership. It is not a routine way to free a live model.

func_8003488C_3548C.title: Initialize the native task lists
func_8003488C_3548C.summary: Initializes the root task and the stock task free list.
func_8003488C_3548C.declaration:
typedef void (*NativeRootTaskUpdate)(void *task, void *object);
extern void func_8003488C_3548C(NativeRootTaskUpdate root_update);
behavior: Initializes the native root task and 79 free task records with a 0xF0-byte stride. Each record is cleared through func_80034A10.
Resets task-list bookkeeping, active task telemetry, the optional display overflow owner, and per-frame display allocation telemetry. Installs root_update as the root task callback.
The free-list head is the pointer at byte +0x08 of D_8006D328. Separately provisioned free records are not included by this initializer.
cautions: Use as an initialization boundary. Calling it on live tasks loses their list and resource ownership.
Task storage uses a 16-byte-aligned 0xF0 stride. The native active task count is unsigned 16-bit.

func_80034B58_35758.title: Allocate and link a child task
func_80034B58_35758.summary: Pops a native task record and inserts it into an existing task list.
func_80034B58_35758.declaration:
typedef void (*NativeChildTaskUpdate)(void *task, void *object);
extern void *func_80034B58_35758(void *parent, NativeChildTaskUpdate update, unsigned short flags);
behavior: Returns null when the task free head is empty. Otherwise increments the unsigned 16-bit active count, pops a free record, and resets it through func_80034A10.
Inserts the task after the parent list word, assigns a backlink at +0x04, sets depth +0x20 to parent depth plus one, installs update at +0x0C and flags at +0x28, and captures native resource context.
The higher-level func_80034E08 additionally applies native depth-order placement after this allocation.
func_80034B58_35758.returns: New linked task, or null when no free record is available.
cautions: The parent must be a live native list owner. This function does not initialize an actor-specific work layout or allocate a display object.

func_80035DFC_369FC.title: Prepend display records to a task
func_80035DFC_369FC.summary: Allocates and prepends a chain of records to a task display list.
func_80035DFC_369FC.declaration: extern void *func_80035DFC_369FC(void *task, short kind, unsigned int count);
behavior: Uses the low eight bits of count, compares the native per-kind capacity against the signed 16-bit active count, then pops records through func_80035D8C.
Prepends each record through task +0x18; initializes the tail at +0x1C only for an empty list. This differs from the appending allocator func_80035EEC.
The capacity table alone does not provide backing records. A failure during a multi-record operation can leave earlier records attached to the task.
func_80035DFC_369FC.returns: First allocated record, or null when capacity/allocation fails.
cautions: Only pass a valid native kind index and a live task. Caller-specific initialization is still required.

func_80018F3C_19B3C.title: Find or allocate a model child cache
func_80018F3C_19B3C.summary: Resolves a cached child record for one native model node.
behavior: Reads the signed byte at model_node +0x04 as a relative node index with 0x18-byte stride, then derives the referenced model command key.
Searches the cache chain rooted at record +0x78. An existing match is retained or moved to the front; a missing match invokes native ancestor-cache reclamation and allocates a kind-2 record.
New nodes store a model key at +0x2C, sibling link at +0x74, child link at +0x78, and parent link at +0x94. Sibling nodes inherit the existing record parent; child nodes point to the existing record.
The stock implementation does not test the allocator result before writing +0x94. Exhausting the shared kind-2 pool can therefore crash inside native drawing.
func_80018F3C_19B3C.returns: Existing or newly allocated cache record; stock allocation failure is unsafe.
cautions: This is an internal render traversal operation, not a standalone model constructor.
Kind-2 capacity includes cached skeleton nodes as well as task-attached root display records.

func_8001904C_19C4C.title: Find or allocate a model sibling cache
func_8001904C_19C4C.summary: Resolves a cached sibling record for one native model node.
behavior: Reads the signed byte at model_node +0x05 as a relative node index with 0x18-byte stride, then derives the referenced model command key.
Searches the cache chain rooted at record +0x74. An existing match is retained or moved to the front; a missing match invokes native ancestor-cache reclamation and allocates a kind-2 record.
New nodes store a model key at +0x2C, sibling link at +0x74, child link at +0x78, and parent link at +0x94. Sibling nodes inherit the existing record parent; child nodes point to the existing record.
The stock implementation does not test the allocator result before writing +0x94. Exhausting the shared kind-2 pool can therefore crash inside native drawing.
func_8001904C_19C4C.returns: Existing or newly allocated cache record; stock allocation failure is unsafe.
cautions: This is an internal render traversal operation, not a standalone model constructor.
Kind-2 capacity includes cached skeleton nodes as well as task-attached root display records.

func_80018B28_19728.title: Render the root of a cached model tree
func_80018B28_19728.summary: Sets up the root cache and traverses native child and sibling nodes.
func_80018B28_19728.declaration: extern void func_80018B28_19728(const void *model_node, void *context_argument, void *cache_record);
behavior: When cache_record is null, allocates a kind-2 root, sets its parent +0x94 to null, and stores it in the current render object at +0x78.

Writes the root model key at +0x2C, submits nonzero model geometry, and resolves child/sibling caches through func_80018F3C and func_8001904C before recursive rendering. Removes stale child/sibling caches when the corresponding model-node index is zero.
The second argument is saved but not consumed in the inspected implementation. The current object comes from D_801684A0.
The stock initial allocation is dereferenced without a null check. The apparent replacement branch at 80018B68 is unreachable: a boolean 0/1 value is ANDed with 0x8FFFFFFE.
cautions: Requires a valid native render context and bound model segments. It is not safe to call from arbitrary gameplay code.
A null cache may require many subsequent child/sibling allocations; reserving one root record is insufficient.

func_80018CA0_198A0.title: Traverse cached model nodes
func_80018CA0_198A0.summary: Recursively renders model node geometry and linked child/sibling branches.
behavior: Builds per-node transforms, resolves segmented nested model references, submits geometry and materials, and traverses relative +0x04/+0x05 node branches.
Traversal uses the native temporary matrix stack and final graphics-bank matrix/display-list cursors. Those graphics resources are distinct from CPU kind-2 cache records.
Native child/sibling cache lookup can allocate records during this render traversal.
cautions: Requires native segment/material context, valid acyclic model data, and sufficient matrix/display-list storage. Increasing CPU record capacity does not increase graphics-bank capacity.

func_80019160_19D60.title: Reclaim a matching ancestor cache
func_80019160_19D60.summary: Walks ancestor model caches looking for a matching recyclable subtree.
func_80019160_19D60.declaration: extern int func_80019160_19D60(void *record, unsigned int model_command);
behavior: Walks parent links at +0x94. For an ancestor with a sibling cache at +0x74, searches for model_command and frees a matching subtree through the native cache reclamation path.
The caller passes the complete cache command key, including its model-type tag. Child and sibling cache constructors invoke this before requesting a new record.
func_80019160_19D60.returns: One when a matching cache was reclaimed, otherwise zero.
cautions: record must be valid and nonnull. This mutates a live native cache tree and must run only in its renderer lifecycle.

func_80036388_36F88.title: Promote an existing child cache
func_80036388_36F88.summary: Moves an existing cached model record to the front of its sibling chain.
behavior: Searches the existing chain rooted at parent +0x78, unlinks record from its old position, and places it at the front. Per-record next-sibling links use +0x74.
No allocation or initialization occurs. The caller must have already found the requested record in this exact chain.
func_80036388_36F88.returns: One on the successful native move, zero for explicitly rejected null inputs.
cautions: Passing an unrelated record is unsafe: native traversal assumes membership and can dereference a null link.

func_800363F4_36FF4.title: Promote an existing sibling cache
func_800363F4_36FF4.summary: Moves an existing cached model record to the front of its sibling chain.
behavior: Searches the existing chain rooted at parent +0x74, unlinks record from its old position, and places it at the front. Per-record next-sibling links use +0x74.
No allocation or initialization occurs. The caller must have already found the requested record in this exact chain.
func_800363F4_36FF4.returns: One on the successful native move, zero for explicitly rejected null inputs.

func_8003674C_3734C.title: Release the cached child subtree
func_8003674C_3734C.summary: Detaches and releases one cached model subtree.
behavior: Detaches the tree rooted at record +0x78 by clearing that link, recursively returns its descendant cache records through the native kind-2 free path, then releases the detached root.
Native recursive cleanup has an internal 32-entry traversal stack; it is not an unbounded generic tree destructor. Record reset preserves each newly installed free-list link.
func_8003674C_3734C.returns: One for an empty or successfully released subtree; zero if native recursive cleanup fails.
cautions: record must remain live. Only release caches whose ownership and native lifecycle are known.

func_80036798_37398.title: Release the cached sibling subtree
func_80036798_37398.summary: Detaches and releases one cached model subtree.
behavior: Detaches the tree rooted at record +0x74 by clearing that link, recursively returns its descendant cache records through the native kind-2 free path, then releases the detached root.
Native recursive cleanup has an internal 32-entry traversal stack; it is not an unbounded generic tree destructor. Record reset preserves each newly installed free-list link.
func_80036798_37398.returns: One for an empty or successfully released subtree; zero if native recursive cleanup fails.
cautions: record must remain live. Only release caches whose ownership and native lifecycle are known.

func_800196F0_1A2F0.title: Submit model geometry in the current render context
func_800196F0_1A2F0.summary: Emits native segment, material, matrix and geometry commands.
behavior: Uses D_801684A0 segment bases and material context to append graphics commands. Context tag bits select direct material calls or an inline material-command copy.
Depending on native transform mode, may emit a matrix and geometry commands using current graphics-bank cursors. CPU model records are not the storage for those submitted matrices.
Generic inline material data can produce a variable number of commands. A fixed command budget requires a constrained verified material/model path.
cautions: Only call under the native renderer with bound segments and valid graphics cursors. Segmented command values are not arbitrary native pointers.

D_8016DAC0_16E6C0.title: Per-kind display free-list heads
D_8016DAC0_16E6C0.summary: Pointer table of free display records indexed by native kind.
behavior: Each entry is a native 32-bit head pointer. Entry 2 is the kind-2 model/display free list at address 8016DAC8.
Free records link through their first word. The low seven bits of byte +0x04 identify the kind; bit7 marks the retired state and is cleared by allocation.

Kind-2 stock storage comprises 192 records of stride 0x98. Allocation/free updates the separate signed 16-bit active-counter table. Increasing a capacity scalar without provisioning this linked storage does not create records.
cautions: This is pointer storage, not a contiguous array of model records. Do not change a live free list without preserving reset/release semantics.

D_8006D328_6DF28.title: Native task-list state
D_8006D328_6DF28.summary: Storage containing native active-list and free-list task pointers.
behavior: The verified pointer words at offsets 0x00,0x04 and0x08 hold the root/list pointers and free head; unsigned 16-bit at 0x0C is the active task count.

Native initialization builds 79 free 0xF0-byte task records plus the separate root. The allocator resets popped tasks, sets their +0x04 backlinks, and the free path returns them to the same linked free head.
cautions: This symbol names storage at the beginning of task-list state, not a task object. Pointer words are 32-bit in the native ABI.
Mutating list pointers without the native backlink/depth rules corrupts task traversal.

D_801684A0_1690A0.title: Current render-object context
D_801684A0_1690A0.summary: Pointer to the object whose segments and material context are active during native drawing.
behavior: Native model traversal temporarily changes this pointer while binding nested render context, then restores the previous object.
Root cache allocation attaches its cached tree at current_object +0x78. Geometry submission reads segment pairs starting at +0x34 and material/context at +0x30.
cautions: Only meaningful at the corresponding renderer boundary. Do not retain it as an actor owner or replace it during unrelated gameplay code.
